info.name: Petproject API - Comprehensive
info.description: Every unique Spring MVC controller and webhook mapping discovered across services. Run Login first for bearer chaining. Limitations: replace the empty accessToken/refreshToken variables with credentials for your environment; localhost URLs and service ports must be reachable or overridden per environment. Collection-level bearer auth applies by default, while public login and webhook requests may override it. Service-to-service endpoints may require a SERVICE token and admin endpoints require an ADMIN token; the collection does not provision Keycloak users, secrets, Kafka, databases, or external provider credentials. DTO-aligned examples are provided; replace placeholder UUIDs and credentials for your environment.
